# Leaflet.VectorGrid 1.3.0 (vendored)

Byte-for-byte copy of the bundled build in the npm package `leaflet.vectorgrid@1.3.0`, added 2026-10-02 so that the portals no longer load it from unpkg.com. The bundle includes its protobuf-tile dependencies (geojson-vt, pbf, vector-tile, topojson).

- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet.vectorgrid/-/leaflet.vectorgrid-1.3.0.tgz (the file unpkg.com serves at https://unpkg.com/leaflet.vectorgrid@1.3.0/dist/Leaflet.VectorGrid.bundled.js).
- Version: 1.3.0.
- Licence: Beerware, as the package declares. The package ships no licence file, so `LICENSE` reproduces the notice from its README.
- Package integrity (npm registry `dist.integrity`, SHA-512 of the tarball): `sha512-kWmj1pKM+MVdo/7Mg5zsB3YrGZvo/uIuiANV9MvWUFOG+Y2xAJzrteDhoIcCgTjHSSRJ36xdeGdIQVhuWjnCZw==`.
